images.seen: 29 states; Hongshan and A-Group gone at year end, Mari and Kish founded; every culture sits in its own region, no speckle, no holes; Cliopatria has only Egypt, the Sumerian strip and Elam, so the other 25 are dossier-drawn on purpose

Early Dynastic Egypt, Sumerian city-states and Elam match Cliopatria; Ebla and Mari are added from dossiers (Cliopatria lacks them) and sit in plausible places; Kish is a 4-cell speck inside the Sumerian strip, as its dossier gives it; nothing else changes across the window

After the Hongshan end the West Liao basin (Inner Mongolia, Liaoning) is blank; Longshan, Dawenkou, Majiayao, Qujialing, Liangzhu, Jeulmun and Jomon are drawn from dossier keyframes (Cliopatria has none) and are internally consistent

issues.what: Hongshan culture ends at -2900 (548 cells, the packet's only large change) and its successor Xiaoheyan (3000-2000 BCE) has no dossier, so the West Liao basin is blank from -2899 to the next window and beyond. The page confirms the end date ('dated from about 4700 to 2900 BC') and names Xiaoheyan (3000-2000 BCE) and Lower Xiajiadian (2200-1600 BC) as followers but gives no area for either, so no patch can draw them.
A-Group culture ends at -2900 (134 cells in northern Sudan); the end date matches its dossier and the packet. Nothing is wrong.

Mari (-2900, 40 cells) and Kish (-2900, 4 cells) founded as the dossiers say; Kish is a very small speck inside the Sumerian city-states' land, which is the dossier's own region ('Kish'), not a compiler fault.

Longshan culture's -3000 keyframe takes all of Shanxi (a northern prong up to the Inner Mongolian edge) although its own note names only Taosi in the south of the province; it also spans Henan and the Guanzhong, giving an odd arm westward toward the Majiayao blobs. The keyframe runs -3000..-2601 and starts in the previous window, so a patch would reach outside my window; left alone.
issues.decision: left: pages silent (keyframe starts in m3000-m2901; no page opened on it)
